blocks.text: Orttirma daraja: the oldest, the most expensive

Bir narsa guruhdagi **hamma** narsadan ustun ekanini aytish uchun **orttirma daraja** (superlative) kerak. O'zbek tilida bu juda oson: sifat oldiga **eng** qo'yiladi, sifat o'zgarmaydi — **eng** katta, **eng** qimmat, **eng** yaxshi. Ingliz tilida esa qiyosiy darajadagidek (87-dars) ikki yo'l bor: qisqa sifatga `-est` (the old**est**), uzun sifat oldiga **the most** (the **most** expensive). Ikkalasida ham oldida deyarli doim **the** turadi — chunki gap bitta, aniq narsa haqida: guruhdagi «eng ...»si faqat bitta bo'ladi.

Qoidalar 87-darsdagi bilan bir xil, faqat `-er` o'rniga `-est`, **more** o'rniga **the most**. Bir bo'g'inli sifat: tall → the tall**est**. `-e` bilan tugasa — faqat `-st`: nice → the nice**st**, large → the large**st**. Undoshdan keyingi `-y` → `-iest`: happy → the happ**iest**, busy → the bus**iest**. «Bitta unli + bitta undosh» bo'lsa, undosh ikkilanadi: big → the bi**gg**est, hot → the ho**tt**est. Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifat — **the most**: the most beautiful, the most popular, the most dangerous.

rows: tall → the tall**est**, cold → the cold**est**, fast → the fast**est**
nice → the nice**st**, safe → the safe**st**, large → the large**st**
happy → the happ**iest**, easy → the eas**iest**, funny → the funn**iest**
big → the bi**gg**est, hot → the ho**tt**est, thin → the thi**nn**est
the **most** famous, the **most** comfortable, the **most** important

items.text: Who is **the tallest** person in your class?
August is **the hottest** month in Bukhara.
This is **the most comfortable** chair in the house.

blocks.text: Noto'g'ri shakllar: the best, the worst, the furthest

87-darsdagi uchta noto'g'ri so'z orttirma darajada ham boshqacha: good / well → **the best**, bad / badly → **the worst**, far → **the furthest** (yoki the farthest). «the goodest», «the most good», «the baddest» — xato.
in yoki of: the tallest in the world

Orttirma darajadan keyin «qayerda, qaysi guruhda eng ...» ekanini aytish uchun joy va guruh bilan **in** ishlatiladi: the tallest building **in** the world (dunyodagi), the best student **in** the class (sinfdagi), the oldest city **in** Uzbekistan. **of** esa son va vaqt bilan: the youngest **of** the three brothers (uch aka-ukaning), the best day **of** my life, the coldest month **of** the year. O'zbekchada bularning ko'pi `-dagi` yoki qaratqich bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun «of the world» deb xato qilish oson.

**one of the** + orttirma daraja + **ko'plik ot** — «eng ... lardan biri»: Samarkand is **one of the oldest cities** in the world. Ot albatta ko'plikda bo'ladi: one of the oldest **cities**, «city» emas.

items.text: Russia is **the biggest** country **in** the world.
Bekzod is **the youngest of** the three brothers.
Khiva is **one of the most beautiful towns** in Uzbekistan.

blocks.text: Orttirma daraja ko'pincha Present Perfect va **ever** bilan keladi (17-dars): It's **the best** film **I've ever seen** — Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film. Ma'nosi — «hayotim davomida shu paytgacha ko'rganlarimning ichida eng ...». O'zbekchada bu sifatdosh bilan aytiladi: men **ko'rgan**, siz **borgan**, biz **yegan**. British English'da bu yerda Past Simple emas, Present Perfect ishlatiladi: «the best film I ever saw» emas, **I've ever seen**.

items.text: This is **the best** soup **I've ever tasted**.
items.translation: Bu men **tatib ko'rgan eng mazali** sho'rva.

items.text: What's **the most beautiful** place **you've ever been** to?
It was **the worst** journey **we've ever had**.
items.translation: Bu **biz qilgan eng yomon** safar bo'ldi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «It is best film» → It's **the** best film (the tushib qolmasin); «the most biggest» → **the biggest**; «the most good» → **the best**; «the tallest building of the world» → **in** the world; «one of the best city» → one of the best **cities**; «the best film I ever saw» → **I've ever seen** (British English).

Qaysi daraja? Ikki narsa taqqoslansa — qiyosiy: Tom is **taller than** Aziz. Uch va undan ko'p narsa ichidan bittasi — orttirma: Tom is **the tallest** in the team. O'zbekchada ham shunday: `-roq` / `-dan` — ikki narsa, **eng** — guruh ichida.
Bog'lanish: qiyosiy daraja — 87-dars; than — 88-dars; as ... as — 89-dars; Have you ever ...? — 17-dars.

rows: eng yaxshi, eng yomon, eng uzoq
the best **in** the class / the best day **of** my life
sinfdagi eng yaxshi / hayotimdagi eng yaxshi kun

examples.title: **the -est**: **the tallest**, **the cheapest**
examples.description: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar: **the** + sifat + `-est`: the old**est**, the tall**est**. O'zbekchada **eng**: **eng** baland. **the** deyarli doim kerak.

sentences.text: Who is **the tallest** in your family?
sentences.translation: Oilangizda kim **eng baland**?

sentences.text: Ben Nevis is **the highest** mountain in Britain.
sentences.translation: Ben-Nevis — Britaniyadagi **eng baland** tog'.

sentences.text: This is **the cheapest** hotel in town, but it's clean.
sentences.translation: Bu shahardagi **eng arzon** mehmonxona, lekin toza.

sentences.text: My grandmother is **the oldest** person in our street.
sentences.translation: Buvim ko'chamizdagi **eng keksa** odam.

sentences.text: What's **the fastest** way to get to the airport?
sentences.translation: Aeroportga borishning **eng tez** yo'li qaysi?

sentences.text: December 21st is usually **the shortest** day of the year.
sentences.translation: 21-dekabr odatda yilning **eng qisqa** kuni.

sentences.text: Aziz is **the youngest** of four brothers.
sentences.translation: Aziz to'rt aka-ukaning **eng kichigi**.

sentences.text: Which is **the longest** river in the UK? — The Severn.
sentences.translation: Buyuk Britaniyadagi **eng uzun** daryo qaysi? — Severn.

sentences.text: Sarah always buys **the freshest** bread at the market near her house.
sentences.translation: Sara doim uyi yaqinidagi bozordan **eng yangi** nonni oladi.

sentences.text: We arrived late, so we got **the smallest** room in the hotel.
sentences.translation: Kech kelganimiz uchun mehmonxonadagi **eng kichik** xona bizga tegdi.

examples.title: Spelling: **the biggest**, **the nicest**, **the happiest**
examples.description: Yozilishi 87-darsdagidek: nice → **the nicest**, big → **the biggest**, hot → **the hottest**, happy → **the happiest**, busy → **the busiest**.

sentences.text: July is **the hottest** month in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Iyul — Toshkentdagi **eng issiq** oy.

sentences.text: Aziz ordered **the biggest** pizza on the menu.
sentences.translation: Aziz menyudagi **eng katta** pitsani buyurtma qildi.

sentences.text: That was **the easiest** question in the test.
sentences.translation: Bu testdagi **eng oson** savol edi.

sentences.text: The wedding was **the happiest** day of their lives.
sentences.translation: To'y ularning hayotidagi **eng baxtli** kun bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Madina has got **the nicest** smile in the class.
sentences.translation: Sinfda **eng yoqimli** tabassum Madinada.

sentences.text: Monday is always **the busiest** day at the office.
sentences.translation: Ofisda dushanba doim **eng band** kun.

sentences.text: Tashkent is **the largest** city in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Toshkent — Markaziy Osiyodagi **eng yirik** shahar.

sentences.text: Which is **the safest** area for tourists in London?
sentences.translation: Londonda sayyohlar uchun **eng xavfsiz** hudud qaysi?

sentences.text: Tom told **the funniest** story about his first day at work.
sentences.translation: Tom ishdagi birinchi kuni haqida **eng kulgili** voqeani aytib berdi.

sentences.text: Our neighbours have got **the noisiest** dog in the street — it barks all night.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimizning iti ko'chadagi **eng shovqinli** it — tun bo'yi huradi.

examples.title: **the most** + long adjectives
examples.description: Uzun sifatlar — **the most** + sifat: **the most expensive**, **the most beautiful**. «the expensivest» degan shakl yo'q.

sentences.text: This is **the most expensive** restaurant in the city.
sentences.translation: Bu shahardagi **eng qimmat** restoran.

sentences.text: For many people, the Registan is **the most beautiful** place in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik uchun Registon — Samarqanddagi **eng go'zal** joy.

sentences.text: What's **the most difficult** thing about learning English?
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini o'rganishning **eng qiyin** tomoni nima?

sentences.text: In Britain football is **the most popular** sport, but cricket is popular too.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada futbol — **eng ommabop** sport, lekin kriket ham mashhur.

sentences.text: The last chapter is **the most interesting** part of the book.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi bob — kitobning **eng qiziq** qismi.

sentences.text: Who is **the most famous** writer in your country?
sentences.translation: Mamlakatingizdagi **eng mashhur** yozuvchi kim?

sentences.text: We bought **the most comfortable** sofa in the shop, and it wasn't cheap.
sentences.translation: Do'kondagi **eng qulay** divanni oldik, u arzon ham emas edi.

sentences.text: Health is **the most important** thing in life.
sentences.translation: Sog'liq — hayotdagi **eng muhim** narsa.

sentences.text: Driving in the mountains at night is **the most dangerous** part of the trip.
sentences.translation: Kechasi tog'da mashina haydash — safarning **eng xavfli** qismi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza is **the most hard-working** student in our group.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza — guruhimizdagi **eng tirishqoq** talaba.

examples.title: Irregular: **the best**, **the worst**, **the furthest**
examples.description: Noto'g'ri shakllar: good → **the best**, bad → **the worst**, far → **the furthest**. «the goodest», «the most good» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: Aziz is **the best** player in our team.
sentences.translation: Aziz — jamoamizdagi **eng yaxshi** o'yinchi.

sentences.text: That was **the worst** day of my holiday.
sentences.translation: Bu ta'tilimning **eng yomon** kuni edi.

sentences.text: Which shop has got **the best** prices?
sentences.translation: Qaysi do'konda narxlar **eng ma'qul**?

sentences.text: Neptune is **the furthest** planet from the Sun.
sentences.translation: Neptun — Quyoshdan **eng uzoq** sayyora.

sentences.text: Emma got **the best** mark in the exam.
sentences.translation: Emma imtihonda **eng yaxshi** baho oldi.

sentences.text: Traffic is always **the worst** on Friday evenings.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlik doim juma kuni kechqurun **eng yomon** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Of all my friends, Bekzod lives **the furthest** from the city centre.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarim orasida shahar markazidan **eng uzoqda** Bekzod yashaydi.

sentences.text: What's **the best** time to visit Uzbekistan? — Spring or autumn.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonga borishning **eng yaxshi** vaqti qachon? — Bahor yoki kuz.

sentences.text: My brother is **the worst** cook in the family — he burns everything!
sentences.translation: Akam oilamizdagi **eng yomon** oshpaz — hamma narsani kuydiradi!

sentences.text: **The best** way to learn a language is to speak it every day.
sentences.translation: Tilni o'rganishning **eng yaxshi** yo'li — uni har kuni gapirish.

examples.title: **in** the world, **of** the year
examples.description: Joy va guruh bilan — **in**: the tallest building **in** the world. Son va vaqt bilan — **of**: the youngest **of** the three, the coldest month **of** the year.

sentences.text: The Pacific is **the biggest** ocean **in** the world.
sentences.translation: Tinch okeani — **dunyodagi eng katta** okean.

sentences.text: Who is **the oldest** student **in** your group?
sentences.translation: **Guruhingizdagi eng katta** talaba kim?

sentences.text: Madina is **the youngest of** the three sisters.
sentences.translation: Madina uch opa-singilning **eng kichigi**.

sentences.text: Graduation day was **the proudest** moment **of** my life.
sentences.translation: Bitiruv kuni — **hayotimdagi eng faxrli** lahza edi.

sentences.text: January is **the coldest** month **of** the year in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda yanvar — **yilning eng sovuq** oyi.

sentences.text: Oxford is **the oldest** university **in** the English-speaking world.
sentences.translation: Oksford — **ingliz tilli dunyodagi eng qadimgi** universitet.

sentences.text: Which is **the cheapest of** these three phones?
sentences.translation: **Bu uch telefonning qaysi biri eng arzon**?

sentences.text: Khazret Sultan is **the highest** mountain **in** Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Hazrati Sulton — **O'zbekistondagi eng baland** tog'.

sentences.text: This is **the busiest** street **in** Tashkent at rush hour.
sentences.translation: Bu — tig'iz paytda **Toshkentdagi eng gavjum** ko'cha.

sentences.text: James was **the fastest of** all the runners, but he fell just before the finish.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **barcha yuguruvchilarning eng tezi** edi, lekin marraga yetmasdan yiqilib tushdi.

examples.title: **one of the oldest cities**
examples.description: **one of the** + orttirma daraja + **ko'plik** ot — «eng ... lardan biri»: one of **the oldest cities**. Ot ko'plikda bo'lishi shart.

sentences.text: Samarkand is **one of the oldest cities** in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Samarqand — Markaziy Osiyodagi **eng qadimiy shaharlardan biri**.

sentences.text: Plov is **one of the most popular dishes** in Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Palov — O'zbekistondagi **eng mashhur taomlardan biri**.

sentences.text: Manchester United is **one of the biggest clubs** in England.
sentences.translation: Manchester Yunayted — Angliyadagi **eng yirik klublardan biri**.

sentences.text: It was **one of the coldest winters** in fifty years.
sentences.translation: Bu so'nggi ellik yildagi **eng sovuq qishlardan biri** edi.

sentences.text: Dr Karimov is **one of the best doctors** in the hospital.
sentences.translation: Doktor Karimov — shifoxonadagi **eng yaxshi shifokorlardan biri**.

sentences.text: Is London **one of the most expensive cities** in Europe? — Yes, it is.
sentences.translation: London Yevropadagi **eng qimmat shaharlardan birimi**? — Ha, shunday.

sentences.text: Learning to drive was **one of the hardest things** I've done.
sentences.translation: Mashina haydashni o'rganish men qilgan **eng qiyin ishlardan biri** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Our neighbour Tom is **one of the kindest people** I know.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnimiz Tom — men taniydigan **eng mehribon odamlardan biri**.

sentences.text: The Silk Road was **one of the most important trade routes** in history.
sentences.translation: Ipak yo'li tarixdagi **eng muhim savdo yo'llaridan biri** bo'lgan.

sentences.text: Bukhara has got **some of the most beautiful** buildings in the country.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda mamlakatdagi **eng go'zal binolarning ba'zilari** bor.

examples.title: **the best** ... **I've ever** ...
examples.description: Orttirma daraja + Present Perfect + **ever** — «hayotimda ... eng ...»: **the best** film **I've ever seen** — men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film. Savol → javob juftliklari bilan.

sentences.text: This is **the best** pizza **I've ever eaten**!
sentences.translation: Bu men **hayotimda yegan eng zo'r** pitsa!

sentences.text: What's **the most interesting** place **you've ever visited**? — Khiva.
sentences.translation: **Siz borgan eng qiziq** joy qaysi? — Xiva.

sentences.text: That was **the worst** film **I've ever seen**.
sentences.translation: Bu men **ko'rgan eng yomon** film edi.

sentences.text: Who's **the most famous** person **you've ever met**?
sentences.translation: **Siz uchratgan eng mashhur** odam kim?

sentences.text: It's **the hottest** summer **we've ever had** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Bu Toshkentda **biz ko'rgan eng issiq** yoz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza is **the most generous** person **I've ever known**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza — men **tanigan eng saxiy** inson.

sentences.text: What's **the longest** journey **you've ever made**? — From London to Tashkent by train!
sentences.translation: **Siz qilgan eng uzoq** safar qaysi? — Londondan Toshkentgacha poyezdda!

sentences.text: Is this **the cheapest** flight **you've ever found**? — Yes, only fifty pounds.
sentences.translation: Bu **siz topgan eng arzon** reysmi? — Ha, atigi ellik funt.

sentences.text: Bekzod says it's **the most difficult** exam **he's ever taken**.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning aytishicha, bu **u topshirgan eng qiyin** imtihon.

sentences.text: Thank you — that's **the nicest** thing **anyone has ever said** to me.
sentences.translation: Rahmat — bu menga **aytilgan eng yoqimli** gap.

examples.title: Quiz: **bigger** or **the biggest**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: viktorina — qiyosiy (**bigger than**) va orttirma (**the biggest**) yonma-yon. Ikki narsa — `-er` / more, uch va undan ko'p — the `-est` / the most.

sentences.text: Which is **bigger**, the Sun or the Moon? — The Sun, of course.
sentences.translation: Qaysi biri **kattaroq**, Quyoshmi yoki Oy? — Albatta, Quyosh.

sentences.text: What's **the biggest** animal in the world? — The blue whale.
sentences.translation: Dunyodagi **eng katta** hayvon qaysi? — Ko'k kit.

sentences.text: Is Mercury **closer** to the Sun **than** Venus? — Yes, it's **the closest** planet.
sentences.translation: Merkuriy Quyoshga Veneradan **yaqinroqmi**? — Ha, u **eng yaqin** sayyora.

sentences.text: Which country has **the largest** population in Central Asia? — Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Markaziy Osiyoda qaysi davlat aholisi **eng ko'p**? — O'zbekiston.

sentences.text: Is Samarkand **older than** Tashkent? — Yes, by several centuries.
sentences.translation: Samarqand Toshkentdan **qadimiyroqmi**? — Ha, bir necha asrga.

sentences.text: Which is **colder** in Tashkent, December or January? — January, usually.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda qaysi oy **sovuqroq** — dekabrmi yoki yanvar? — Odatda yanvar.

sentences.text: In the UK, which city is **the most expensive**? — London, without doubt.
sentences.translation: Buyuk Britaniyada qaysi shahar **eng qimmat**? — Shubhasiz, London.

sentences.text: Is a cheetah **faster than** a horse? — Yes, it's **the fastest** animal on land.
sentences.translation: Gepard otdan **tezroqmi**? — Ha, u quruqlikdagi **eng tez** hayvon.

sentences.text: Who's **the best** footballer in your class? — Aziz, but Bekzod is **better** at tennis.
sentences.translation: Sinfingizdagi **eng yaxshi** futbolchi kim? — Aziz, lekin tennisda Bekzod **yaxshiroq**.

sentences.text: My answers were **worse than** yours, but they weren't **the worst** in the class!
sentences.translation: Mening javoblarim siznikidan **yomonroq** edi, lekin sinfdagi **eng yomoni** emas edi!
